newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list six new equity options on Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list six new equity options on Dec 31.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said it would list options on six over-the-counter shares on December 31.

The new contracts are options on shares of Periphonics Corp, Secure Computing Corp, Sylvan Learning Systems Inc, Heartland Wireless Communications Inc, Heartstream Inc and Offshore Logistics Inc, the exchange said.
All six issues will have initial expiration months of January, February, May and August.
Periphonics options will have initial strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30. GHM Inc will be the specialist unit on the AMEX floor.
Secure Computing options will have strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2, and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist unit.
Sylvan options will open with strikes of 22-1/2, 25 and 30. Gargoyle Specialist LP will be the specialist unit.
Heartland Wireless options will have strikes of 10, 12-1/2 and 15. Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist unit.
Heartstream options starts with strikes of 10, 12-1/2 and 15. Charlton, Goin, SLK will be the specialist unit.
Offshore Logistics options will have strike prices of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2. Group One Trading LP will be the specialist unit.
